mentions.name: XDP/eBPF Load Balancer
mentions.description: This project is an XDP/eBPF-based load balancer, shipped with a Golang control plane library and an application intended to replace high-capacity legacy load balancing appliances with commodity off-the-shelf (COTS) servers.
mentions.problem: High-capacity legacy load balancing appliances; this replaces them with COTS servers.
mentions.source_excerpt: An XDP/eBPF load balancer with Golang control plane library and an application to replace high capacity legacy appliances with COTS servers.
